snippet.title: Psycho Dead - Official Console Reveal Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Psycho Dead is a third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers. Psycho Dead will be available on PC (GOG and Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
